creators.name: Ian Curtis
creators.role: Product designer & creative technologist (XRarchitect); designer at World Labs
creators.bio: Architect-turned-XR designer known online as @XRarchitect; worked on AR at 8th Wall, Niantic and Niantic Spatial and now designs world-model tools at World Labs.
creators.why: One of the most consistent public AR prototypers on X, turning each new AR capability into a short, shareable design experiment.

creators.name: Abhishek Singh
creators.role: Indie AR developer & inventor (Peeqo, Super Mario AR); founder of Rara
creators.bio: NYC-based developer and former NYU ITP resident researcher who recreates pop-culture games and films as life-size AR experiences and builds playful gadgets like the GIF robot Peeqo.
creators.why: His life-size Super Mario Bros in Central Park and street-scale Street Fighter became defining viral images of what consumer AR could feel like.

creators.name: Laan Labs (Chris Laan)
creators.role: Independent computer-vision & AR studio (AirMeasure, 3d Scanner App)
creators.bio: Small independent lab run by Chris Laan and Jason Laan that ships computer-vision and AR apps such as AirMeasure, 3d Scanner App and AirDraw.
creators.why: From day one of ARKit they posted a stream of inventive prototypes—3D drawing, levitating phones, neural brush textures, Gaussian splats in AR—that set the tone for the scene.

creators.name: Matthew Hallberg
creators.role: AR developer and YouTuber; Snap Spectacles developer
creators.bio: Unity AR developer whose YouTube channel mixes tutorials with ambitious builds, from ARKit Minecraft and Portal to Iron Man HUDs and Snap Spectacles games.
creators.why: He turned the first weeks of ARKit into iconic open-source demos (AR Minecraft, Pokémon Go-style GPS AR, Portal) that a generation of developers learned from.

creators.name: Jerome Etienne
creators.bio: French web developer behind learningthreejs and AR.js, the open-source library that brought 60fps marker-based AR to any phone browser in 2017.
creators.why: AR.js made AR run in a plain web page on cheap phones, and his playful demos—portals, refraction, invisibility cloaks—showed the web could do magic.

creators.name: Takashi Yoshinaga
creators.role: AR/VR researcher & rapid prototyper (ISIT Fukuoka); Microsoft MVP for Mixed Reality
creators.bio: Researcher at ISIT Fukuoka with a PhD in AR-based remote healthcare, who has posted hundreds of AR prototypes since 2009 and runs the AR Fukuoka community; creator of HoloTuberKit.
creators.why: An extraordinarily prolific prototyper who keeps inventing ways to stream, copy and share real space—point-cloud telepresence over YouTube, spatial copy-paste, LiDAR room sharing—across every AR device.

creators.name: Kitasenju Design (Takayuki Watanabe)
creators.role: Programmer & digital artist; real-time CG studio
creators.bio: One-person studio of programmer-artist Takayuki Watanabe that experiments with real-time visual expression and ships AR effect apps like MEISAI and SUPER SLIT SCAN.
creators.why: His ARKit experiments—LiDAR boxelization, human-segmentation glitch and pixel effects—treat AR as a new visual medium rather than a utility.

creators.name: Lucas Rizzotto
creators.role: XR creator, inventor and YouTuber (Lucas Builds the Future); founder of Where Thoughts Go
creators.bio: Brazilian-born immersive designer and inventor behind the 'Lucas Builds the Future' channel and AR House in LA, known for absurd yet insightful AR, VR and AI builds.
creators.why: He storifies AR prototypes—a working Marauder's Map, a portal to his best friend, clothes that play music—into viral narratives that make the future feel personal.

creators.name: Andrew Hart
creators.role: iOS developer; creator of ARKit+CoreLocation; founder of Dent Reality / Hyper
creators.bio: iOS developer who open-sourced ARKit+CoreLocation in 2017, pioneering phone AR navigation, then founded Dent Reality (now Hyper) for indoor AR wayfinding.
creators.why: His July 2017 tweets showing AR turn-by-turn arrows on real streets defined location-based AR for the ARKit era.

creators.name: Nathan Gitter
creators.role: Designer & engineer; human interface designer at Apple
creators.bio: Designer-engineer who shared playful ARKit and TrueDepth prototypes in 2017–2018, wrote the widely read 'What I Learned Making 5 ARKit Prototypes', and later joined Apple's human interface team.
creators.why: His image-tracking prototypes (living newspapers, time-travelling graffiti) were among the clearest demonstrations of AR as interface design, cited in Apple's WWDC18 AR design talk.

creators.name: Matt Moss
creators.role: iOS developer & founder (Hawkeye Access, Locket Camera)
creators.bio: Young iOS developer whose 2018 ARKit 2 eye-tracking prototype went viral and became Hawkeye Access; later founded the widget photo app Locket.
creators.why: He showed on WWDC week 2018 that ARKit face tracking could turn gaze and blinks into a hands-free interface for the whole phone.

creators.name: Brad Dwyer
creators.role: Developer & founder (Hatchlings, Magic Sudoku; co-founder of Roboflow)
creators.bio: Des Moines developer whose studio Hatchlings shipped Magic Sudoku and Nose Zone at the ARKit and iPhone X launches before he co-founded the computer-vision company Roboflow.
creators.why: Magic Sudoku was an early proof that ARKit plus on-device machine learning could read the real world and write answers back onto it.

creators.name: Morten Just
creators.role: Designer & indie developer (Rotato, Design Camera); former Google designer
creators.bio: Danish designer and indie Mac/iOS developer who prototypes interface ideas in public; his ARKit experiments led to the Design Camera and Rotato apps.
creators.why: His everyday-object AR prototypes—kitchen timers on pots, web pages wrapped around books, stencils for drawing—are precise, human-scale interface ideas.

creators.name: Mark Dawson
creators.role: Software engineer; author of 'ARKit by Example'
creators.bio: Engineer whose 2017 'ARKit by Example' blog series and demos taught many early ARKit developers, later followed by LiDAR meshing experiments on the 2020 iPad Pro.
creators.why: His Van Gogh bedroom in a kitchen and LiDAR Matrix room were memorable early proofs of how ARKit could restage real space.

creators.name: Glen Rhodes
creators.bio: Game developer who published some of the very first Unity + ARKit experiments in June 2017, days after the iOS 11 beta, testing scale, occlusion and placement.
creators.why: His first-week demos—a Titanic sailing across a lake, an armada over his house, real-wall occlusion—captured the initial shock of stable phone AR.

creators.name: Isaac Cohen (Cabbibo)
creators.role: Artist & creative coder; VR/AR experience designer
creators.bio: Artist-coder known as Cabbibo who makes joyful, tactile interactive worlds in WebGL, VR and AR, such as Blarp! and ARQUA!.
creators.why: ARQUA! used your body as the controller to fill real rooms with rainbow aquarium life, treating ARKit as a medium for delight and agency.

works.title: Super Mario Bros Recreated as Life-Size AR Game
works.description: He rebuilt World 1-1 of Super Mario Bros at life size and played it in first person in Central Park, hitting blocks and stomping Goombas through a HoloLens.
works.idea_zh: 把超级马里奥第一关按真人尺寸搬进中央公园，自己扮成马里奥去玩。

works.title: The Ring Brought to Life in AR
works.description: Re-enacts the famous horror scene in which Samara crawls out of the TV and into the living room, anchored to a real television.
works.idea_zh: 让《午夜凶铃》贞子真的从家里电视机里爬出来。

works.title: Street Fighter II: Real World Warrior Edition
works.description: A multiplayer AR remake of Street Fighter II in which two players on phones control full-size fighters battling on real streets.
works.idea_zh: 把街头霸王变成两人同屏的真人尺寸 AR 对战，真正打上街头。

works.title: An Augmented Reality Rube Goldberg Machine
works.description: A chain-reaction machine that mixes real household objects with virtual dominoes, ramps and balls, playable as a physics puzzle with a reset button.
works.idea_zh: 一台横跨真实与虚拟物体的鲁布·戈德堡连锁机关。

works.title: Wile E. Coyote vs the Roadrunner in AR
works.description: Looney Tunes characters chase each other around a real room, with Wile E. Coyote's cartoon traps set against actual furniture.
works.idea_zh: 让威利狼和哔哔鸟的卡通追逐在真实房间里上演。

works.title: Bringing Tattoos to Life Using AR
works.description: Pointing the phone at people's tattoos animates them and plays the personal story behind each design.
works.idea_zh: 对准纹身，纹身图案动起来并讲出背后的故事。

works.title: Musical Chairs Against the Avengers in AR
works.description: A real game of musical chairs in which the other players are life-size virtual Avengers competing for real chairs.
works.idea_zh: 和真人尺寸的复仇者联盟一起抢真实的椅子。

works.title: A Universal Remote Control Built Using AR
works.description: Tapping on real lamps, fans and TVs through the phone camera turns them on and off, using ARKit anchors wired to a Raspberry Pi.
works.idea_zh: 看见哪个家电就点哪个——用 AR 做的万能遥控器。

works.title: Laser Cat AR
works.description: A minimalist AR game whose only goal is to entertain a virtual kitten on your floor with a laser pointer.
works.idea_zh: 唯一玩法是用激光笔逗一只虚拟小猫。

works.title: Bringing AR to the Streets of NYC
works.description: A short street intervention in which virtual objects appear among passers-by on New York sidewalks.
works.idea_zh: 把 AR 奇观直接投放到纽约街头路人中间。

works.title: Drawing in 3D with ARKit
works.description: One of the first ARKit demos: a Tilt Brush-style prototype in which moving the phone leaves glowing strokes hanging in the room.
works.idea_zh: 把手机当画笔，在房间空气里画出立体笔触。

works.title: AirMeasure – AR Tape Measure
works.description: An early AR tape measure: tap two points on real surfaces to measure distance, later extended with floor plans, trajectories and building heights.
works.idea_zh: 用手机点两下就能在真实世界量尺寸的 AR 卷尺。

works.title: ARSpray – AR Spray Paint
works.description: Spray-paint graffiti onto real walls and floors with the phone as a virtual spray can.
works.idea_zh: 手机变喷漆罐，在真实墙面上涂鸦。

works.title: ARKit 3D Point Cloud House Walk-through
works.description: Logs every raw ARKit feature point while walking through a house, revealing the building as a sparse point cloud with the camera path drawn in green.
works.idea_zh: 把 ARKit 看到的特征点全部记录下来，走一圈房子就长出点云。

works.title: Magic Floating iPhone
works.description: A real iPhone on the table is swapped for a virtual copy that lifts off and levitates, with particles in a second take.
works.idea_zh: 把桌上的真手机替换成虚拟副本，让它悬浮起来。

works.title: Hiding Stuff with ARKit
works.description: Live textures captured from the surroundings are laid over real objects so they seem to vanish from the scene.
works.idea_zh: 用周围环境的实时纹理盖住物体，让它“隐身”。

works.title: Avocado Toast with ARKit
works.description: A small computer-vision and ARKit test that detects a real avocado and replaces it with avocado toast.
works.idea_zh: 识别真实牛油果，并把它变成牛油果吐司。

works.title: Realistic AR Brush Texture with Deep Learning
works.description: A neural network turns photos into painterly textures that are hung on real walls as AR paintings.
works.idea_zh: 用神经网络把照片变成油画笔触，挂到真实墙上。

works.title: Parallel Parking with AR
works.description: A prototype AR guide that measures a parking spot from the sidewalk and shows whether and how the car will fit.
works.idea_zh: 先在路边量出车位，再用 AR 指引侧方停车。

works.title: ARKit 1.5 Vertical Planes and Meshes
works.description: Visualises ARKit 1.5's wall detection and irregular surface meshes as they grow over a room.
works.idea_zh: 实时可视化 ARKit 1.5 识别的墙面和不规则表面网格。

works.title: ARKit + CoreML Foot Detection for AR Soccer
works.description: A foot-segmentation neural net lets the player kick a virtual soccer ball with their real foot.
works.idea_zh: 用神经网络识别真实的脚，去踢虚拟足球。

works.title: ARKit Home Robot
works.description: A cheap home robot built from the discontinued Romo base and an iPhone, localised with ARKit and Placenote and driven from another phone.
works.idea_zh: 用停产的 Romo 底座加 iPhone，做一台靠 ARKit 定位的家用机器人。

works.title: AR Roaches Crawling on Everything
works.description: Using 6D.ai real-time meshing, virtual cockroaches scurry over and behind the actual objects in a kitchen.
works.idea_zh: 借助实时网格，让虚拟蟑螂爬满厨房的每个表面。

works.title: AR Bocce Ball Measuring
works.description: AirMeasure detects bocce balls on the lawn and shows which one is closest to the jack.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 判断地滚球谁离目标球更近。

works.title: ARHide
works.description: A LiDAR-era experiment that makes real objects in the scene disappear or turn translucent in AR.
works.idea_zh: LiDAR 时代的“隐身”实验：让真实物体从画面中消失。

works.title: Metal Particles v2
works.description: Metal-driven particle systems that flow over the LiDAR-scanned geometry of a real room.
works.idea_zh: 让 Metal 粒子沿着 LiDAR 扫描出的房间表面流动。

works.title: Augmented Reality 3D Gaussian Splatting in Real Time
works.description: A custom iOS Metal renderer places animated volumetric Gaussian-splat captures of people into the real world in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把高斯泼溅捕捉的动态真人实时放进 AR 空间。

works.title: AirDraw – Finger Paint AR for Vision Pro
works.description: Finger-painting in 3D space on Apple Vision Pro, later extended with the Logitech Muse stylus for 3D calligraphy and a voxel brush.
works.idea_zh: 在 Vision Pro 里直接用手指在空中作画。

works.title: Apple ARKit Augmented Reality Minecraft
works.description: Place and break Minecraft blocks at life size on real ground, one of the most shared ARKit demos of summer 2017.
works.idea_zh: 把《我的世界》方块以真实尺寸搭在现实地面上。

works.title: ARKit Pokémon Go with Unity GPS and Mapbox
works.description: A Pokémon Go-style demo that combines ARKit tracking with Mapbox GPS so creatures stand at real-world locations.
works.idea_zh: 把 ARKit 和 GPS 地图结合，做真正落在街道上的宝可梦。

works.title: ARKit Portal to the Upside Down
works.description: A walk-through doorway in the living room that opens into the dark 'Upside Down' world from Stranger Things.
works.idea_zh: 在客厅开一道通往《怪奇物语》颠倒世界的传送门。

works.title: Valve's Portal in Unity with ARKit
works.description: Uses ARKit 1.5 vertical-plane detection to shoot linked blue and orange portals onto real walls and see through them.
works.idea_zh: 在真实墙面上打出《传送门》里的蓝橙传送门。

works.title: Memes + AR with Watson
works.description: Say a phrase aloud and the matching meme image is searched and dropped into the room on a detected ground plane.
works.idea_zh: 说出一句话，对应的表情包就出现在房间里。

works.title: An Augmented Reality Web Browser
works.description: Floating, resizable web pages placed around physical space, an early take on spatial-computing windows on Android.
works.idea_zh: 把网页窗口漂浮在真实空间中，早期的空间计算浏览器。

works.title: AR Iron Man HUD
works.description: A phone-in-headset JARVIS HUD that tracks a real phone, listens to voice commands and wires in Alexa skills.
works.idea_zh: 用手机加廉价头盔自制钢铁侠 JARVIS 头显。

works.title: Real Life Doodles (Creator Cam)
works.description: An AR app built in a week-long devlog that turns flat doodles into objects living in the real world.
works.idea_zh: 把随手涂鸦变成真实空间里的 AR 物体。

works.title: AR Photoshop Plugin
works.description: A Photoshop plugin streams each layer of a document to a phone so the layers can be pulled out of the monitor and viewed in AR.
works.idea_zh: 把 Photoshop 图层从显示器里“拽”出来放进 AR。

works.title: AR Blasters on Snap Spectacles
works.description: A phone becomes a blaster controller over BLE for a shooting game on Snap Spectacles AR glasses.
works.idea_zh: 手机变成光枪控制器，在 Spectacles 眼镜里打 AR 射击。

works.title: Physical Pokémon Cards in AR
works.description: Real Pokémon trading cards are recognised on Spectacles and their creatures appear on top of the table.
works.idea_zh: 识别实体宝可梦卡牌，让卡里的宝可梦跳上桌面。

works.title: Augmented Reality in Your Browser
works.description: A 2012 screencast showing marker-based AR running in a desktop web browser via WebRTC webcam access and JSARToolKit.
works.idea_zh: 2012 年就在浏览器里跑起来的网页 AR。

works.title: Augmented Pong in 3D
works.description: A 3D Pong game in which the paddles are driven by physical markers held in front of the webcam.
works.idea_zh: 拿着实体标记当球拍，在浏览器里打 3D 乒乓。

works.title: Augmented Gesture with Post-its
works.description: Cheap coloured Post-it notes on the fingers become gesture trackers for controlling a web 3D scene.
works.idea_zh: 把便利贴贴在手指上，就成了网页手势追踪器。

works.title: Punch a Doom Character in AR
works.description: A browser mini-game in which you punch a Doom monster that appears in your webcam view.
works.idea_zh: 对着摄像头挥拳，打浏览器里的 Doom 怪物。

works.title: AR.js – Efficient Augmented Reality for the Web
works.description: Launch demo of AR.js: pure-JavaScript marker AR running at 60fps on an old phone, with no app install.
works.idea_zh: 纯网页、无需安装、老手机也能 60 帧运行的 AR。

works.title: AR-Code: QR Code to AR in Under 5 Seconds
works.description: Scanning a QR code opens a web page that immediately shows AR content on the same marker, measuring cold-start time to AR.
works.idea_zh: 扫一个二维码，5 秒内进入网页 AR。

works.title: Hole in the Wall with AR.js
works.description: A marker on a surface opens a convincing hole that reveals a virtual space inside the wall.
works.idea_zh: 一张标记就在墙上开出一个洞，看见墙里的空间。

works.title: Invisibility Cloak for AR.js
works.description: A Harry Potter-style cloak effect that makes the marker and objects on it vanish.
works.idea_zh: 哈利·波特式隐身斗篷，让标记和物体一起消失。

works.title: Liquid Marker Matrix Style
works.description: The camera image around a marker ripples like liquid, 'liquifying reality' in the style of The Matrix.
works.idea_zh: 让标记周围的现实画面像液体一样波动。

works.title: Refraction in AR.js
works.description: Glass-like virtual objects refract the live camera feed so they blend into the real desk; a larger glass torus fills his apartment.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟玻璃物体折射真实画面，与现实融为一体。

works.title: AR Swimming Pool
works.description: A tiny pool with a rubber duck and fish lives inside a marker on the desk, seen through a cut-out in the table.
works.idea_zh: 桌面上嵌进去一个有小黄鸭和鱼的迷你泳池。

works.title: Hologram Bird in AR.js
works.description: A Star Wars-style hologram bird delivers a message from a marker, prototyping an AR business card.
works.idea_zh: 星战式全息小鸟从名片上跳出来传话。

works.title: Measure It with AR.js
works.description: Measures the distance between two AR markers in the browser and draws it as a live ruler.
works.idea_zh: 在浏览器里实时测量两个 AR 标记的距离。

works.title: Area Learning with Multi-Markers
works.description: Several markers scattered around a room are learned together so content stays anchored across a larger area, even under hand occlusion.
works.idea_zh: 多个标记联合学习，让网页 AR 覆盖整个房间。

works.title: Augmenting Any Webpage with AR.js
works.description: A snippet that adds AR to an ordinary web page, so visitors see 3D content popping out of the page itself.
works.idea_zh: 给任意网页加一段代码，内容就从网页里跳出来。

works.title: AR.js on Tango with WebAR Playground
works.description: Markerless web AR on a Google Tango phone, placing A-Frame objects directly on real surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 在 Tango 手机上跑无需标记的网页 AR。

works.title: Hatsune Miku Dancing in My Living Room
works.description: A dancing Hatsune Miku model performs on the living room floor using AR.js on Tango and A-Frame.
works.idea_zh: 让初音未来在自家客厅地板上跳舞。

works.title: Two-Way AR Portal with A-Frame 360
works.description: A walk-through portal door that shows a 360 world from outside and the real room from inside.
works.idea_zh: 一扇双向传送门：外面看是 360 世界，进去回看是现实房间。

works.title: Walking in VR Using AR.js Tracking
works.description: Uses AR.js positional tracking to physically walk into the A-Frame logo in virtual reality.
works.idea_zh: 借用 AR.js 的定位，在 VR 里真正走进 A-Frame 标志。

works.title: WebXR Studio on Augmented Website
works.description: A browser authoring tool that lets anyone compose AR scenes and publish them on an 'augmented website' viewable on any phone.
works.idea_zh: 在浏览器里拼装 AR 场景，并直接发布成“增强网站”。

works.title: AR Tele-Echography (2009)
works.description: A remote doctor guides a local operator's ultrasound probe in real time using AR overlays that show where and how to move it.
works.idea_zh: 远程医生用 AR 叠加指引本地人员操作超声探头。

works.title: Holoportation for ARCore with Multiple Azure Kinect
works.description: Several Azure Kinects capture a person as a live point cloud that is streamed into an ARCore phone as a life-size hologram.
works.idea_zh: 多台 Azure Kinect 实时捕捉真人点云，传送到手机 AR 里成为全息人。

works.title: Streaming Holograms to ARCore via YouTube
works.description: Encodes RGB-D point clouds into an ordinary YouTube live stream so anyone's phone can decode and view them as AR holograms (the basis of HoloTuberKit).
works.idea_zh: 把全息点云编码进普通 YouTube 直播，用手机解码成 AR 全息影像。

works.title: Spatial Copy and Paste Shared with ARCore
works.description: Selects a region of the real room on HoloLens 2, 'copies' it as a mesh, and pastes the captured space into another user's ARCore view.
works.idea_zh: 在 HoloLens 上“复制”一块真实空间，再“粘贴”到别人的手机 AR 里。

works.title: Room Scan with iPad LiDAR and AR Visualization
works.description: A prototype room scanner that builds a coloured mesh of the room with the new iPad Pro LiDAR and overlays it back onto reality.
works.idea_zh: 用 iPad LiDAR 扫描房间，并把网格叠回现实中查看。

works.title: Real-Time LiDAR Point Cloud Streaming from iPad Pro
works.description: Streams the iPad Pro's live LiDAR point cloud to a remote PC and other XR devices, later with a cartoon-style rendering.
works.idea_zh: 把 iPad LiDAR 实时点云直播给远端设备。

works.title: LiDAR Point Cloud Streaming with Cartoon Effect
works.description: The iPad's live point cloud of a room and person is re-rendered on the receiving side as a hand-drawn cartoon.
works.idea_zh: 把实时点云渲染成卡通风格的远程空间。

works.title: HoloBox with HoloLens 2
works.description: A physical box-shaped display and HoloLens 2 share synchronised objects that move seamlessly between the screen's 3D window and the air around it.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟物体在立体显示盒与 HoloLens 空间之间无缝穿梭。

works.title: Holo Cat: Perspective Expression by Head Tracking
works.description: A flat screen shows his cat as a 3D hologram whose perspective shifts with the viewer's head, with no headset needed.
works.idea_zh: 用头部追踪让平面屏幕上的猫咪看起来立体。

works.title: AR Shooter Shared Between Nreal Light and iPad
works.description: A co-located AR shooting game in which a glasses wearer and an iPad player see and fight the same virtual targets.
works.idea_zh: 眼镜玩家和 iPad 玩家在同一空间合作打 AR 射击。

works.title: AR Light Saber with MediaPipe and p5.js
works.description: A browser toy that detects your hand with MediaPipe and draws a glowing lightsaber extending from it on the webcam feed.
works.idea_zh: 网页里用手势识别，从手中长出一把光剑。

works.title: Real-Time AR Effect on Cat
works.description: Tracks his pet cat in real time and wraps it in animated AR effects that follow the animal as it moves.
works.idea_zh: 实时追踪家猫，给它身上叠加跟随的 AR 特效。

works.title: Mixed Reality Door for Meta Quest 3
works.description: A real door in the room becomes a portal: opening it in passthrough reveals a virtual world behind it.
works.idea_zh: 把家里一扇真实的门变成通往虚拟世界的传送门。

works.title: Copy and Paste Room Mesh with Meta Quest 3
works.description: Grabs a chunk of the scanned room mesh and pastes duplicates of real furniture elsewhere in passthrough.
works.idea_zh: 在 Quest 3 里把真实房间的一块网格复制粘贴到别处。

works.title: DejaViewer: Replaying Past Motion in AR
works.description: Records motion in the field of view from Quest colour and depth cameras and replays it on the spot as a ghostly point cloud.
works.idea_zh: 把刚才发生在眼前的动作录下来，原地以点云“回放过去”。

works.title: StickAR: Spatial Notes Beyond Typing
works.description: Hand-written or spoken notes are recognised and pinned as 3D sticky notes in space, avoiding keyboards in AR/VR.
works.idea_zh: 不用键盘，把手写或语音笔记变成贴在空间里的便利贴。

works.title: JIDO-RHYTHM Selfie Music Video
works.description: A selfie music-video app that deforms and animates your tracked face in time with the music.
works.idea_zh: 自拍音乐视频：脸部被追踪并随节奏变形。

works.title: AR_Glitch
works.description: A generative glitch effect that tears and displaces the live camera image around the space.
works.idea_zh: 让现实画面在空间中产生生成式的故障撕裂。

works.title: Particles Face
works.description: The tracked face dissolves into a flowing compute-shader particle cloud.
works.idea_zh: 把追踪到的人脸分解成流动的粒子云。

works.title: ARKit3 Body Tracking Effects
works.description: Generative graphics attached to a tracked human skeleton follow a dancer's movements.
works.idea_zh: 给 ARKit3 追踪到的人体骨骼附上生成式图形。

works.title: Pixelation with Human Segmentation
works.description: People are cut out of the scene with ARKit3 segmentation and re-rendered as moving pixel mosaics.
works.idea_zh: 把画面里的人抠出来，变成流动的像素马赛克。

works.title: MEISAI – AR Filter App
works.description: An iOS AR effect app offering camouflage-like generative filters that reshape people and space in real time.
works.idea_zh: 像“迷彩”一样实时改写人和空间的生成式 AR 滤镜 App。

works.title: AR Drawing
works.description: Strokes drawn with the phone hang in space as stylised 3D lines.
works.idea_zh: 用手机在空中画出风格化的立体线条。

works.title: Fast Plane Detection and Classification with LiDAR
works.description: Visualises the LiDAR iPad Pro instantly classifying floor, walls, ceiling and furniture as coloured surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 可视化 LiDAR 瞬间识别出地板、墙、天花板和家具。

works.title: $100 Wallpaper Using ARKit
works.description: Re-skins the walls of a real room with virtual wallpaper using LiDAR scene geometry.
works.idea_zh: 用 LiDAR 给真实房间换一张虚拟墙纸。

works.title: Physics Simulation with ARKit 3.5
works.description: Virtual objects bounce and pile up on the LiDAR-scanned furniture and floor.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟物体在 LiDAR 扫描的家具上真实碰撞堆叠。

works.title: Unity-chan and Occlusion
works.description: A dancing Unity-chan character is correctly hidden by real people and furniture using ARKit depth occlusion.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟角色会被真实的人和家具正确遮挡。

works.title: Virtual Flowers Using ARKit
works.description: Generative flowers sprout and bloom across the scanned surfaces of a room.
works.idea_zh: 生成式花朵沿着房间表面生长绽放。

works.title: Realtime Boxelization with ARKit4 and LiDAR
works.description: The whole room, including people, is converted in real time into a field of voxel boxes.
works.idea_zh: 把整个房间连同人实时体素化成方块。

works.title: Minecraft Filter
works.description: A LiDAR filter that renders the surrounding room as blocky Minecraft-style geometry.
works.idea_zh: 把身边的真实房间渲染成《我的世界》方块风格。

works.title: Drawing in the Air
works.description: Lines drawn in mid-air settle into the room as persistent 3D ribbons.
works.idea_zh: 在空中画出的线化作留在房间里的立体丝带。

works.title: SUPER SLIT SCAN
works.description: A slit-scan camera app that smears time across the frame, turning moving people into stretched, warped sculptures.
works.idea_zh: 用狭缝扫描把时间铺进画面，把人变成扭曲的时空雕塑。

works.title: Kohkoku: Reality and Illusion AR
works.description: AR artwork for the Japanese magazine Kohkoku's 'reality and illusion' issue, animating printed pages through the phone.
works.idea_zh: 为《广告》杂志“虚实”特辑做的 AR 作品，让纸面在手机里动起来。

works.title: MyLab – Holographic Chemistry App
works.description: A HoloLens chemistry education app in which students build and inspect atoms and molecules as holograms in the room.
works.idea_zh: 在 HoloLens 里用全息原子分子学化学。

works.title: CyberSnake – Holographic Snake
works.description: The classic Snake game re-imagined in HoloLens: you are the snake, hunting burgers around your home while avoiding your own growing tail.
works.idea_zh: 你就是贪吃蛇：在家里走动吃汉堡，还要躲开自己的尾巴。

works.title: 1000 Michael Scotts Screaming at You in AR
works.description: An absurdist phone AR piece that fills the room with a crowd of screaming Michael Scotts.
works.idea_zh: 让一千个《办公室》里的 Michael Scott 在房间里对你尖叫。

works.title: Holograms That React to Music in Your Room
works.description: Paint audio-reactive holograms all over a room that pulse and morph with whatever music is playing (with Stephen Hodgson).
works.idea_zh: 在房间各处布置会随音乐跳动的全息图形。

works.title: A Futuristic Portal to My Best Friend
works.description: A quarantine project: a mixed-reality 'portal' that opens a window from his apartment into his best friend's space so they can hang out as virtual roommates.
works.idea_zh: 疫情隔离期间，做一道连接好友家的混合现实传送门，当“虚拟室友”。

works.title: A Working Marauder's Map – Harry Potter AR
works.description: In a rented 'mini Hogwarts' castle in England, a physical parchment viewed through the phone shows everyone's live GPS position as walking footprints with name labels, like Harry Potter's Marauder's Map.
works.idea_zh: 做一张真能显示城堡里每个人实时位置的“活点地图”。

works.title: I Turned My Girlfriend into a Musical Instrument
works.description: Body-tracked AR turns a dancer's limbs into triggers that play live music as she moves.
works.idea_zh: 用身体追踪让女友的每个动作都成为演奏的乐器。

works.title: Live Music with My Clothes in AR
works.description: A live performance in which touching different parts of his outfit triggers AR instruments and visuals.
works.idea_zh: 拍打衣服的不同部位，就能用 AR 现场演奏音乐。

works.title: Pillow – Mixed Reality in Bed
works.description: A Quest mixed-reality app designed to be used lying in bed, with games, journaling and meditation projected over the ceiling and room.
works.idea_zh: 专为躺在床上设计的混合现实应用。

works.title: Turning My Ceiling into a Planetarium
works.description: Mixed reality replaces the bedroom ceiling with a live star field and planets.
works.idea_zh: 用混合现实把卧室天花板变成星空天象馆。

works.title: ARKit + CoreLocation
works.description: Floating labels pinned to real-world landmarks by GPS stay locked in place as he walks through London, combining ARKit tracking with CoreLocation.
works.idea_zh: 把 GPS 地标标签稳稳钉在真实街景上。

works.title: ARKit + CoreLocation Part 2: AR Turn-by-Turn Navigation
works.description: AR arrows and route lines are drawn on the actual street, leading the walker turn by turn to the destination.
works.idea_zh: 第一次把导航箭头直接画在真实街道上。

works.title: Dent Reality Indoor AR
works.description: An indoor AR wayfinding prototype that guides shoppers to products and locations inside buildings with overlays anchored to the space.
works.idea_zh: 在商场等室内空间里用 AR 指路找商品。

works.title: Rainbrow – Eyebrow-Controlled Game
works.description: An iPhone X game controlled with your face: raise your eyebrows to fly up, lower them to go down, using TrueDepth face tracking.
works.idea_zh: 用挑眉毛来控制角色上下的 iPhone X 游戏。

works.title: Bringing Newspapers to Life with ARKit
works.description: Pointing the phone at a printed newspaper plays animated weather maps and sports highlights on top of the page.
works.idea_zh: 对准报纸，天气图和体育集锦就在纸面上动起来。

works.title: Exploring Paintings in AR
works.description: Looking at a painting identifies its key figures, which can be tapped to learn more about them.
works.idea_zh: 对准名画识别画中人物，点一下就能了解其故事。

works.title: Time Travel in AR
works.description: In a public graffiti park whose walls change daily, the phone shows earlier versions of the artwork in place, letting you see into the past.
works.idea_zh: 在每天都被覆盖的涂鸦墙前，用 AR 看到它过去的样子。

works.title: Control Your iPhone with Your Eyes
works.description: Look at a button to select it and blink to press it: an ARKit 2 prototype that turns eye gaze into a pointer on iPhone X.
works.idea_zh: 看哪里就选中哪里，眨眼就点击——用眼睛操控 iPhone。

works.title: Hawkeye Access
works.description: The shipped version of his prototype: browse any website hands-free on iOS by looking at links and blinking to open them.
works.idea_zh: 把眼控原型做成可上架的免手浏览器，服务无障碍需求。

works.title: Magic Sudoku
works.description: Point the phone at a printed Sudoku and the solution appears written into the empty squares on the paper, using Vision, CoreML and ARKit.
works.idea_zh: 对准纸上的数独，答案直接“写”进空格里。

works.title: ARKit 2 Eye Transform Test
works.description: A quick test of ARKit 2's per-eye transforms, drawing where each eye is looking as input for his face-controlled game Nose Zone.
works.idea_zh: 测试 ARKit 2 的双眼追踪，为用脸玩的游戏做新操控。

works.title: Kitchen Timers in Augmented Reality
works.description: Countdown timers float above real pots on the stove, rendered with motion blur, adaptive lighting and depth of field.
works.idea_zh: 让倒计时器悬浮在灶台上正在煮的锅上方。

works.title: Counting Foreign Currency in AR
works.description: Banknotes on a table are recognised and their converted value is shown on top of each note.
works.idea_zh: 识别桌上的外币纸币，并直接在纸币上显示换算金额。

works.title: Instructions in AR
works.description: Hand-written technical instructions are attached to the real device they explain, using live image tracking.
works.idea_zh: 把手写的操作说明贴在它所说明的真实设备上。

works.title: Augmented Reality Web Pages on Physical Books
works.description: A physical book is recognised and wrapped with its live web page—reviews and details float around the cover.
works.idea_zh: 认出实体书，把它的网页信息包裹在书的周围。

works.title: Stenciling in Augmented Reality
works.description: Projects a reference image onto paper through the phone so you can trace it by hand, giving instant drawing skills.
works.idea_zh: 把参考图“投”到纸上，让任何人都能照着描出好画。

works.title: Design Camera 3D + AR
works.description: Places an infinitely scalable, photoreal iPhone showing your app design on any real surface for mockup photography.
works.idea_zh: 把展示你 App 设计的逼真 iPhone 模型放在任意真实桌面上拍摄。

works.title: ARKit Virtual Van Gogh Bedroom Tour
works.description: A life-size 3D model of Van Gogh's painting 'Bedroom in Arles' is placed in his kitchen to walk around in.
works.idea_zh: 把梵高《阿尔的卧室》按真实尺寸搬进自家厨房里走进去看。

works.title: ARKit Light Estimation Demo
works.description: A virtual cube brightens and dims as he switches real room lights on and off, showing ARKit light estimation.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟物体的明暗随房间真实灯光变化。

works.title: 3D Scene Reconstruction with iPad Pro LiDAR
works.description: Scans a room live with the iPad Pro LiDAR and renders the growing mesh with shading and grid lines.
works.idea_zh: 用 iPad LiDAR 实时重建房间网格。

works.title: iPad Pro LiDAR Matrix Simulation
works.description: The scanned room is texture-mapped with falling green Matrix code, turning his house into the digital rain.
works.idea_zh: 把扫描出的房间贴满《黑客帝国》的绿色代码雨。

works.title: Experiment: Building a City in ARKit
works.description: Choose buildings from a menu and place them to grow a miniature town on the sofa.
works.idea_zh: 在沙发上一栋栋摆放建筑，搭出一座迷你城市。

works.title: The Armada Arrives
works.description: A fleet of enormous spaceships hovers above his house, testing how very large virtual objects feel in ARKit.
works.idea_zh: 一支巨型舰队悬停在自家房子上空。

works.title: Titanic AR Demo
works.description: At a real lake, a full-size Titanic appears on the water and sails off into the distance.
works.idea_zh: 在真实湖面上，一艘等大的泰坦尼克号缓缓驶远。

works.title: ARKit Real-World Geometry Occlusion
works.description: Depth masks mapped onto real walls at runtime let physical architecture hide virtual objects behind it.
works.idea_zh: 给真实墙面贴上深度遮罩，让虚拟物体躲到墙后面。

works.title: ARQUA!
works.description: An ARKit launch app for building a rainbow fantasy aquarium in your room—placing kelp, fish schools and crystal rods by moving your body as the controller (with Viacom NEXT).
works.idea_zh: 在房间里用身体当控制器，搭建一座彩虹梦幻水族馆。
